projectSummary: Independent confirmation that the layered description of the insertion is contested in the primary anatomical literature, which is the same disagreement the imaging-and-histology study resolves against a bilaminar enthesis.

publication.statusSource: Crossref REST API works record plus the Crossref/Retraction Watch CSV export, both fetched 2026-09-13

notes: Abstract-only; the study's own numeric findings were not retrievable.

study.intervention: Cadaveric anatomical study of the distal humeral insertion.
study.population: The paper states that the precise description of the pectoralis major distal humeral insertion remains controversial; that the distal tendon is classically described as two layers, one anterior and one posterior, regrouping at their distal edge; that most authors hold the clavicular head to participate in the anterior layer; and that others describe a more superficial termination in close relationship with the deltoid humeral insertion. Its stated objective is to make that description precise.

title: Distal insertion of the clavicular portion of pectoralis major muscle: anatomical study.
